summary: M39r · Tournament Finance Console (MPCA-owned flow) verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 12/12 real assertions green (3 skips due to intentional state consumption by earlier tests — flow effectively covered by test_full_flow_on_revision_requested_row + test_request_revision_flow_on_sent_row). Frontend: MPCA console renders header (title/scheme/cycle), batch actions bar, 4-row status matrix with per-row status pill / proposed / sanctioned / spent / claim / next-action + waiting-on chip; row-level fc-send-{code} button for Drafts, fc-sanction-{code} for Accepted rows, and fc-view-{code} everywhere. Division view renders fc-div-budget-card + fc-div-accept-btn + fc-div-revise-btn only when the caller's own row is Sent_To_Division; card correctly re-labels to 'Accepted · awaits sanction' after Accept. Action Centre for MPCA correctly emits budget_send + budget_sanction (chips ac-filter-budget_send, ac-filter-budget_sanction; cards visible with amounts + tournament names). State guards return 409 on illegal transitions (sanction on Sent/Draft, accept on Approved). Permission guards return 403 when X-User-Body-Code header does not match the target body. Prepare-budgets correctly SKIPS live rows (Sent/Accepted/Approved) and REPLACES Draft/Revision_Requested.
critical_code_review_comments: finance_console.py state machine is clean and idempotent — 409 on wrong-status transitions, 403 on wrong-body header, 422 on approved_total > proposed. Good defensive coverage.
prepare_budgets correctly preserves live budgets (Sent/Accepted/Approved) and only replaces Draft/Revision_Requested — the response schema (created/replaced/skipped) is what the UI needs.
next_action_hint() is the right shape for a matrix — {waiting_on, action}; UI consumes it directly.
Legacy submit/approve/return/reject endpoints preserved as promised; /tournaments/:id/finance/legacy route still opens.

Minor: /sanction endpoint accepts approved_head_allocations but does not enforce that head labels line up with proposed heads — a rogue payload could rename heads. Not exploitable via UI but worth a whitelist check.
Minor: send-budgets returns 400 with 'No draft budgets to send' when called on a tournament with no drafts — consider 200 + empty sent array for idempotency (UI currently handles both).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all data-testids present + Accept & Sanction click-through both fire and update state
